data.name: Muniyappan
data.gender_notes: Muniyappan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muniyappan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Muni' meaning sage and 'appan' meaning father. It is believed to be the name of a form of Lord Murugan, the Hindu deity of war and love, who is known for his mercy and compassion towards his devotees. The name Muniyappan carries the meaning “God of mercy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muniyappan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies wisdom, mercy, and compassion.
data.etymology: Muniyappan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muniyappan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
